programme.title: Fatherhood

programme.title: Charlie's Angels: Full Throttle
programme.desc: The Angels track down rings containing the names of those in the FBI's witness protection programme. However, the witnesses begin to get murdered one by one.

programme.title: Smurfs: The Lost Village
programme.desc: Smurfette and her friends go to the Forbidden Forest to find a lost village. When the evil wizard Gargamel gets to know of this, he devises a plan to stop the smurfs from discovering the town.

programme.title: Alpha
programme.desc: Keda, the young son of a tribe chief, is accidentally left behind and must survive in the wilderness. He then encounters an injured wolf abandoned by its pack and the two form a bond.

programme.title: Bullet Train
programme.desc: Ladybug, a professional assassin, is assigned to retrieve a briefcase from a bullet train. Soon, he finds himself battling many other killers who board the same train but with a different objective.

programme.title: Ghost Rider
programme.desc: Motorcycle stuntman Johnny Blaze gives up his soul to save his father and becomes the Ghost Rider to fight against Blackheart, the son of Mephistopheles, the devil himself.

programme.title: I Know What You Did Last Summer
programme.desc: After a night of revelry, four friends accidentally run over a man and dump his body to conceal their secret, unaware that the following year brings a series of eerie events in their lives.

programme.title: Vertical Limit
programme.desc: When his sister Annie gets trapped in a crevice atop K2 along with her crew, mountain climber Peter Garrett must assemble a team to rescue them before they perish.

programme.title: Spider-Man 3

programme.title: Bad Boys for Life
programme.desc: Old-school cops Mike Lowrey and Marcus Burnett team up with the Miami PD's newly-created elite team to take down the vicious leader of a drug cartel.

programme.title: Hitch
programme.desc: A professional dating expert helps men woo the women of their dreams. However, while helping a hapless client, he finds himself challenged by a gossip columnist.

programme.title: The Ugly Truth

programme.title: Bloodshot
programme.desc: A soldier who died on duty is resurrected and given superhuman abilities by the RST Corp. But soon he realises the truth about his past and his resurrection and sets out to get revenge.

programme.title: Terminator Salvation

programme.title: Monster House
programme.desc: Three teenagers discover that their neighbour's house is actually a monster that hates children. They then decide to destroy the heart of the house and kill it.

programme.title: Zombieland: Double Tap
programme.desc: Columbus, Tallahassee, Wichita and Little Rock set out on a mission to protect the rest of humanity by fighting evolved zombies while also battling their own internal demons.

programme.title: Kraven the Hunter
programme.desc: Prepped to be the successor of his father's drug empire, a near-death experience alters Sergei's physicality. Sergei now treads the path of vengeance as he hunts criminals.

programme.title: Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse
programme.desc: Miles Morales travels the spider-verse and meets a league of spider-people as he fights a new enemy, the Spot. But upon trying to change his canon event, he is pitted against the other Spider-Men.

programme.title: Terminator 3: Rise of the Machines
